headline: Auto segment to drive growth despite tractor’s weakness

highlights: In the near term, the impact of RM inflation may continue to weigh on overall margins; however, management expects headwinds to ease during FY28.
Q2FY27: Revenue in-line, EBITDAM below our estimate M&M’s revenue stood at INR 424.7bn (+27% YoY/+1% QoQ), in line with our estimate.
EBITDA came in at INR 49.5bn (+2% YoY/-3% QoQ), 4% below of our estimate.
EBITDAM, at 11.7% (-290bps YoY/-50bps QoQ), was 50bps below our estimate.
valuation: The views and opinions expressed in this document may or may not match or may be contrary with the views, estimates, rating, and target price of the Retail Research.
watch: In the near term, the impact of RM inflation may continue to weigh on overall margins; however, management expects headwinds to ease during FY28.
Demand trends in underlying auto industry continue to remain robust, while tractors are likely to see muted traction owing to rainfall deficit and drought condition in key regions.
